response.sql:
WITH per_scan AS (
  SELECT crewref, gbsize / spanmin AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0
), per_operator AS (
  SELECT crewref,
         AVG(gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
         AVG((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scans s2 WHERE s2.crewref = p.crewref)) AS avg_scans
  FROM per_scan p
  GROUP BY crewref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_avg
  FROM per_operator
), above_average AS (
  SELECT * FROM per_operator
  WHERE avg_gb_per_minute > (SELECT all_operator_avg FROM overall)
)
SELECT AVG(avg_scans) AS avg_scans_done,
       AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
       AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) - (SELECT all_operator_avg FROM overall) AS avg_excess_gb_per_minute
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: The all-operator figure is the unweighted average of each operator's per-scan GB/minute average; operators with no scans having both values present are excluded because their average is undefined. The scan count per selected operator includes all rows in scans, even scans lacking size or duration.
